cause: Rocq 9.3 reports an inductive or record of the source that the automatic rule declares template-polymorphic
removal: the inductive declares its universe treatment explicitly (#[universes(template=no)] or universe polymorphism), in a successor file where the source is pinned

cause: the source adds universe constraints on a template-polymorphic structure of a library (Ncring.Ring of Stdlib, MathComp structures), which Rocq 9.3 marks fragile
removal: the structures involved stop being template-polymorphic (a library release), or a successor file declares its own structure universe-polymorphic

cause: a library that the plugin test requires loads a Stdlib file deprecated since Rocq 8.20; the warning sits at the Require line
removal: the requiring library drops that file (a release of it), or the test stops requiring the library

cause: a library that the source requires (Stdlib Reals, QArith and the modules that load them, rocq-stdlib 9.2.0) loads Stdlib.ZArith.ZArith_base, deprecated since Stdlib 9.0 in favor of ZArith; the warning sits at the Require line
removal: a rocq-stdlib release whose libraries stop loading ZArith_base, or the source (a successor file where it is pinned) stops requiring those libraries

cause: a Stdlib library that the source requires (rocq-stdlib 9.2.0, the newest release the opam index lists) uses the notation "( _ | _ )", deprecated as inconsistent with pattern syntax; the warning sits at the Require line
removal: a rocq-stdlib release that drops the notation from those libraries, or the source (a successor file where it is pinned) stops requiring them

cause: Hierarchy Builder, which MathComp and the HB commands of the source run, declares an unnamed factory with no source location
removal: a Hierarchy Builder release that attaches locations, or a successor file whose HB commands name their factories

removal: the requiring library stops loading Stdlib.Vectors (a release of it), or the test stops requiring the library
